title: Promote the pwp retro learnings into .tick/learnings.md (two entries)
body: The closeout cannot write .tick/ (run boundary), so the two learnings below live only in this report. (1) Five integrated gates stayed green while ci.yml named a package the epic had deleted: the gate runs 'go test -short ./...', which compiles only what exists, so a stale path in a workflow file cannot fail it and gate and CI drift independently — rule: on any epic that deletes or renames a package, run the CI workflow's named-package steps verbatim on the integrated SHA (until l8l and ticfac:cwa automate it). (2) cloud/sandbox survived 3r2's GOES list and the epic's acceptance criteria with the deviation recorded only in a code comment, invisible to every review surface until closeout attempt 11 — rule: a worker that keeps something its tick's GOES list names for deletion must record the deviation as a tick note or finding at merge time; a code comment is not a record. Apply both under the existing 'Orchestrator gates' section, respecting the 150-line cap.
